# PartitionEmbeddingStatusRequest

Asks for the embedding status of up to 500 partitions in one call.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `partitionIds` | `uuid[]` | yes | The partitions to report on. Unknown ids (or another tenant's) are omitted from the response. Constraints: maxLength: 500, minLength: 1, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |

## Example

```json
{
  "partitionIds": [
    "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
  ]
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`partitions.embeddingStatus`](../api/partitions.md) (`PUT /partitions/embedding-status`)
